sanskrit_verse:
य आहवेषु वध्यन्ते भूम्यर्थमपराङ्मुखाः ।
अकूटैरायुधैर्यान्ति ते स्वर्गं योगिनो यथा ॥३२४॥
transliteration: ya āhaveṣu vadhyante bhūmyartham aparāṅmukhāḥ | akūṭair āyudhair yānti te svargaṃ yogino yathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who die in battle, turned away from personal desire and devoted to the protection of the Earth, attain heaven by means of honest weapons, just as Yogis do through disciplined means.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Dharma, not personal ambition.
Causation is determined by intent directed toward collective welfare.
Capacity-based responsibility arises from conscious commitment to protect the land.
Restoration occurs through elevated consciousness, not punitive consequence.
Consciousness alignment determines post-death trajectory and social recognition.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a warrior dies in defense of the nation AND intent was non-self-seeking, THEN grant ceremonial honor equivalent to national savior status.
IF weapon used is verifiable as non-deceitful AND context confirms righteous engagement, THEN classify death as Dharmic sacrifice.
IF individual demonstrates repeated alignment with collective security, THEN automatically qualify for state-supported spiritual rehabilitation protocols.
IF evidence shows deviation from defensive posture, THEN initiate restorative inquiry without punitive framing.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies in verifying alignment with national Dharma over personal motive. Authority is hierarchically recognized based on sustained commitment to collective integrity. Restoration supersedes retribution when intent aligns with sovereign protection.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causal intent determines karmic outcome; hence, those who act without malice and in service of the Earth are naturally aligned with celestial ascent. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures proportional manifestation—those who act purely ascend proportionally. Responsibility is affirmed through capacity, not fault. The non-punitive reality rule confirms no suffering accrues where purity prevails.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Conduct final rites honoring the deceased's Dharmic commitment.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Family receives national recognition and support for continuing the lineage of service.
Capacity Restoration: Survivors undergo consciousness elevation programs to resolve trauma.
Integrity Reintegration: Society collectively acknowledges the act as sustaining cosmic order.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Justice executed not through punishment but through consciousness restoration. Victory belongs to the Earth; glory to the protector. Reality affirms non-punitivity. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
